verdict.rationale: LegalOS's own USCIS fee calculator estimates Premium Processing fees alongside other filing fees for O-1, L-1, TN, EB-1A/EB-1C, and EB-2 NIW, which covers the cost part of the story. Nothing in the evidence explains how Form I-907 works, which classifications qualify for it, or what it does and does not speed up. Missing for 10: an explanation of I-907 mechanics, a statement of which classifications are eligible for premium processing, clarity on what premium processing speeds up versus what it does not (e.g. adjudication clock only), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider explains premium processing (Form I-907) mechanics — which classifications qualify, what it costs, and what it does and does not speed up

citations.quote: Instantly estimate USCIS filing fees—including the Asylum Program Fee and Premium Processing—for O-1, L-1, TN, EB-1A/EB-1C, and EB-2 NIW.
